title: Technical Project Manager — AI & Data Products (Databricks) | Remote
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
      URL:   https://www.toptal.com/ 
 

 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to lead delivery on AI and data product initiatives built on Databricks. This role blends technical project and program management with data product management and change management — you'll drive execution across technical teams while ensuring the organization actually adopts and adapts to what's being built. If you can manage a delivery roadmap and a change curve with equal fluency, this role is built for that. 
 What You'll Do 
 
 
 Own technical project and program management for AI and data initiatives, including planning, scheduling, and resource coordination 
 
 
 Manage delivery across data and AI workstreams built on Databricks, coordinating cross-functional technical teams 
 
 
 Apply data product management principles to help define scope, prioritization, and roadmap for data/AI products 
 
 
 Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new AI-enabled tools, workflows, or data products across the organization 
 
 
 Translate business objectives into structured project plans, milestones, and delivery roadmaps 
 
 
 Identify and manage project risks, dependencies, and cross-team blockers 
 
 
 Facilitate stakeholder communication, including status reporting, roadmap updates, and executive updates 
 
 
 Coordinate across engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to maintain alignment on priorities 
 
 
 Support governance and structured delivery practices across AI and data programs 
 
 
 What You Bring 
 
 
 Proven experience in technical project management and/or program management, ideally on AI or data-focused initiatives 
 
 
 Working knowledge of artificial intelligence concepts and how AI projects are typically delivered 
 
 
 Experience with or strong familiarity with the Databricks platform and data/AI project workflows 
 
 
 Experience in data product management, including scoping and prioritizing

Experience with AI and data products fits role needs
